topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: Ran into an old face today, or so I thought. Turned out, the rain's not the only thing that washes away the past. Got a call, a name from another time. My heart pounded like it used to in the alleys we'd sneak into, back when the city seemed bigger than the sky. Met up at our old spot, the diner that never changes, same cracked vinyl seats, same sizzle on the grill. But something was off. Ordered the usual for both of us, but it wasn't the same. She didn't laugh at my jokes, not even the bad ones. Asked about the old times, the escapades, but her eyes just glazed over. Said she had no recollection, like I was a stranger. The rain's been falling harder ever since.
